name: QA re-gate: company↔active-project isolation increment after the commit (5 paths, block today)
description:
## Why (qa shift, 2026-11-25T12:xxZ)

Today I pre-gated the uncommitted increment owned by card `4e6c2f24` and the verdict was **block**:

- `qa_review_changes(scope="all", paths=[client/src/utils/companyActiveProject.js, client/src/store/project.js, client/src/views/CompanyView.vue, client/src/router/index.ts, client/tests/company-active-project.test.mjs])` → decision `block`/`require_approval` (medium), changed_files **3 of the 5 named**, mapped_sources 1, unmapped 2, tests_selected 3, **executed 0** (pytest `exit 1` in 0.0 s), coverage: no report.
- `qa_run_tests(suite="npm", paths=["tests/company-active-project.test.mjs"])` → **block / high / tests.no-runner** — `npm: npm not found in PATH`.
- The two **untracked** files (`src/utils/companyActiveProject.js`, `tests/company-active-project.test.mjs`) were absent from the reviewed diff, so the new module and its new test are invisible to the gate until they are staged.

A verdict that is not re-run after the fix is a guess, so this card exists to re-verify it once `4e6c2f24` has committed.

## What to do

1. Wait until `4e6c2f24` reports its commit sha (or until the wake, whichever comes first).
2. Re-run the gate on the committed change: `qa_review_changes(scope="staged")` (empty after a clean commit → then `qa_review_changes(base="HEAD~1", scope="all")` for the increment) and `qa_coverage`.
3. Confirm whether all 5 files are now inside the diff (the untracked-file blindness must be gone once staged). If still 3/5, record it on `acc01b1f`.
4. Post the new numbers on `4e6c2f24`. Do not upgrade the increment to "verified" on a stale verdict.

## Acceptance

- A fresh verdict block (decision, evidence, findings) posted on `4e6c2f24`, quoting the command that produced it.
- The residual gap, if any, is exactly one of: `tests.no-runner` (no node/npm → `91411767`), `tests.run-error` (pytest unimportable → `b19676fe`), or `change.missing-tests` (router/CompanyView).

## Out of scope

Editing product code or tests. Read-only gate plus comments.
